summary: Opt-in Electron demo recorder driven by real product UI and real Agent sessions.
architecture_notes: Session WebSocket events control recording cadence; persisted session messages are consumed only in memory while trusted tool aggregates and whitelisted Project Host readback prove outcomes.
DOM state is used only to operate and frame the product UI, never as product-state authority.

Every case keeps video, sanitized event journal, count/id-only product readback, screenshots, and a structured aggregate result; raw messages, reasoning, tool I/O, credentials, and local paths are never artifacts.
Real Agent runs remain explicit and never join the default unit or E2E suite.
